title: Mechanistic insights into base-free nickel-catalyzed Suzuki–Miyaura cross-coupling of acid fluoride and the origin of chemoselectivity: a DFT study
content:

Palladium-catalyzed Suzuki–Miyaura Coupling (SMC) is a powerful strategy to construct C–C bonds; however, it suffers from the disadvantages of using expensive palladium catalysts and additives.
